title: BA1/758/2017 of Suresh Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
MCRC No. 380/2017 (Modification Appl.)
In
BA1 No. 758 of 2017
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for
the applicant.
Ms. Shivali Joshi, Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Considering the submission of
learned counsel for the parties and
considering the facts mentioned in the
affidavit filed in support of the
modification application and also in the
interest of justice, part of the order
dated 24.07.2017, by which the
applicant was directed to furnish two
reliable & local sureties, is modified to
the extent that the applicant shall
furnish two reliable sureties.
It is directed that the Judge
concerned shall seek the report from the
concerned S.S.P. about the veracity of
the sureties.
Modification Application is,
accordingly, disposed of.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
Arpan 22.09.2017
